result:
The proposed answer is not supported by its own construction, so I reject it.

**Error in the symmetric construction.** Take $|A_1|=|A_2|=|A_3|=2n/3$ and forbid the edges in $A_1\times A_2\times A_3$. The link of $v\in A_1$ is the bipartite graph between $V_2$ and $V_3$ with the block $A_2\times A_3$ removed. Its adjacency matrix $M$ has the block form given in the proposal, so $M M^T$ has block entries $n/3$ times all-ones blocks (not the scalar $2n^2/9$ and $3n^2/9$ the proposal uses). A quotient-matrix computation gives $\lambda^2-\tfrac{n}{3}\lambda-\tfrac{2n^2}{9}=0$, so $\rho(M)=2n/3$, not $n\sqrt{(5+\sqrt{17})/18}\approx 0.712n$.

Check with $n=3$: $M=\begin{pmatrix}0&0&1\\0&0&1\\1&1&1\end{pmatrix}$ has spectral radius $2 = 2n/3$, while the proposed formula gives about $2.136$.

So this barrier gives only $c\ge 2/3$, not $\sqrt{(5+\sqrt{17})/18}$.

**A better barrier.** Take $A_1=V_1$ and $A_2,A_3$ of size $(1/2+\varepsilon)n$ each, and forbid edges in $A_1\times A_2\times A_3$. Then $|A_1\cup A_2\cup A_3|>2n$, and each edge contains at most 2 vertices of $A$, so there is no perfect matching. The link of $v\in A_2$ is $V_1\times(V_3\setminus A_3)$, i.e. $K_{n,n/2}$, with spectral radius about $n/\sqrt2\approx 0.7071n$. The other links are at least this large, so the minimum is about $n/\sqrt2$. This gives $c\ge 1/\sqrt2\approx 0.7071$.

The proposed value $\approx 0.7119$ is not produced by any construction I checked, and it rests on an arithmetic error. The correct threshold is not established by the proposed argument, and the value $0.7119264\ldots$ does not match the lower bound I can verify (which is $1/\sqrt2$, from a construction the proposal does not consider). I have not verified the upper bound, so I cannot state the exact value of $c$ with certainty.

VERDICT: REJECT
